src.name: Wikipedia · Russell Young (artist)
src.q: He moved to London and gained recognition photographing the early live club shows in the late 1970s of Bauhaus, R.E.M. and the Smiths, and with editorial work for magazines including BLITZ, which featured on several front covers.

src.name: Wikipedia · Russell Young (artist)
src.q: In 1998 he relocated to New York, rented a studio in Williamsburg, Brooklyn and worked on a series of ‘Combine Paintings’, assemblages of collage, found objects and street graffiti.

src.name: Wikipedia · Russell Young (artist)
src.q: In September 2000, while living in New York City, he began to concentrate on art and to devote himself to painting.
